tree.heading: Program direction
tree.text: The Secretary shall conduct a program of research, development, demonstration, and commercial application for the purpose of developing economically and environmentally acceptable advanced technologies for oil substitution through coal liquefaction.

tree.heading: Program goals
tree.text: The goals of the program established under subsection (a) shall include—

children.text: improved resource selection and product quality;
the development of technologies to increase net yield of liquid fuel product per ton of coal;
an increase in overall thermal efficiency; and
a reduction in capital and operating costs through technology improvements.

tree.heading: Proposals
tree.text: Within 180 days after October 24, 1992, the Secretary shall solicit proposals for conducting activities under this section.
